messages:
olivia: Heads-up from today's onboarding session: multiple quickstart snippets are out-of-sync with the SDKs. Found three small but blocking issues for new users:
1) Node quickstart omits `await` on `client.generate` causing unhandled promise rejections in examples.
2) Python README uses env var `REDWOOD_KEY` but our SDK checks `REDWOOD_API_KEY`.
3) Some curl examples in the reference docs omit the Authorization header — looks fine for contributors with creds set locally, but breaks copy/paste for newcomers.

sam: ugh, that matches a support ticket I triaged earlier. Thanks for surfacing. Which files exactly?

jared: node path is `docs/quickstart/node/README.md` — the snippet with `client.generate({ ... })` is missing `await`. I'll take that one.

olivia: great. python is `docs/quickstart/python/README.md`. the env var block says `export REDWOOD_KEY=...` while the sample code reads `os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")`. small copy/paste bug.

jared: here's the minimal change I'll PR for node so we keep parity and small diffs:
```js
// before
const result = client.generate({ model: 'gpt-redwood-001', prompt: 'hello' });
console.log(result.output);

// after
const result = await client.generate({ model: 'gpt-redwood-001', prompt: 'hello' });
console.log(result.output);
```
I'll add a one-line note above the sample: "Run inside an async function or top-level await environment."

maria: I'll bundle python env var + curl header fixes into one PR. For curl I'll explicitly add `-H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY"` and a short admonition to avoid real secrets. Also we should replace the naive retry loop in the example — it caused a new user to hammer endpoints and hit 429s.

sam: for retry guidance let's link to the SDK's built-in retry/backoff helpers instead of showing a crude loop. Suggest a sentence like: "Prefer the SDK's retry configuration; see /docs/guides/retries.md for recommended backoff settings."

olivia: agreed. docs-bot reminder: follow style guide — code samples need a one-sentence lead-in, no real secrets, and discourage storing keys in repo.

docs-bot: Reminder: per docs STYLEGUIDE, samples should not contain realistic secrets and must include short explanatory text. See https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/STYLEGUIDE.md :robot_face:

maria: proposed curl snippet to include in the PR:
```bash
# set your API key in CI or env, never commit secrets
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="sk-***"

curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-001","input":"hi"}'
```
I'll also add a short line under onboarding checklist for support to smoke-test quickstart after merges so we catch this earlier.

sam: awesome. once the PRs are open paste links here and i'll review quickly. thanks y'all :heart:

jared: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/531 — node await fix + tiny comment.

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/532 — python env var, curl header, and link to retries guide. Includes an onboarding checklist update.

olivia: reviewing now, will do a quick smoke run of the updated quickstarts. thanks for the speedy fixes! :white_check_mark:
